subject: Staged commit offer + short-term bridge credits
messages:
From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@zenhealth.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Kim <ryan.kim@zenhealth.ai>, procurements@zenhealth.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated pricing options and timing

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our engineering team is excited about moving latency-sensitive endpoints to a dedicated GPU pool, but procurement is asking for a clear migration/financial runway from our current hosted spend into a reserved commit.

Can you share:
- A sample staged commit structure (how credits convert, any taper)
- Any short-term bridge credits available to offset first-week spikes while we onboard
- Typical throughput guarantees and how they map to instance sizing for 8k token Llama variants

We’re targeting a decision by early March. Ryan (cc) is our procurement lead — he’ll handle the SOW and T&Cs.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Tan
Head of AI Platforms, ZenHealth
[sophie.tan@zenhealth.ai]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@zenhealth.ai>
Cc: Ryan Kim <ryan.kim@zenhealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated pricing options and timing

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the clear asks. I’ve attached a concise proposal and a sample commit schedule that we typically use for migrations from hosted to dedicated. High level:

- Staged commit (recommended): 3 steps over 12 months (30% initial commit, 40% at month 4, remaining 30% at month 9). This smooths cashflow and lets us size GPU pools iteratively.
- Conversion credits: We offer a one-time hosted-to-dedicated conversion credit equal to 7x average monthly hosted spend (applies only to CPU/token billable hosted usage) to offset committed ramp. Credit redemption is front-loaded over the first 6 months of the dedicated contract.
- Bridge months: For the first 60 days after go-live we provide up to 100k token-equivalent bridge credits to compensate for onboarding egress and double-running while cache warm-up happens.
- Throughput guarantees: We can commit to 99% of tail P99 latency targets for per-request <=1s on the profile we discussed, with a throughput SLA expressed as tokens/sec per allocated GPU. Exact numbers depend on the model variant; I’ve included sizing assumptions for 8k Llama-XX 16-bit and a quantized 8-bit profile in the spreadsheet.

I’m looping Marissa (account lead) and Karthik (pricing) to ensure we capture any one-off concessions and the legal checklist for credits on the SOW.

Attachments: proposed_commit_schedule.xlsx (sample staging + sizing), RDW-staged-offer-summary.pdf (pricing summary).

Next steps: 1) Confirm the target baseline monthly hosted spend you want converted, 2) confirm preferred cadence for staged commits, 3) we’ll send an offer with exact numbers and DocuSign link.

If useful, we can lock a short-term pilot (2 weeks) on a small dedicated slice to demonstrate throughput before committing.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding Sophie’s asks and my initial outline (below). Quick notes / asks:
- ZenHealth’s last three monthly hosted invoices average ~$85k/mo. They want staged commit options and a bridge while they warm up KV caches / double-run.
- I proposed a 3-step commit (30/40/30) and 7x conversion credit with 6-month redemption + 60-day bridge credits. Is 7x defensible here or do you recommend a sliding scale tied to committed term length?
- Any constraints from finance/legal on front-loading credits/redemption windows?

Please reply with suggested adjustments and a recommended discount band if they sign a 24-month commit.

Thanks —
Sean

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 07:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted -> Dedicated pricing options and timing

Sean / Marissa —

Thanks for the context. Proposed adjustments:

- Conversion credit: move to tiered structure tied to committed term: 6x monthly hosted spend for 12-month commit, 8x for 24-month commit. Keeps us flexible and rewards longer commitments.
- Redemption cadence: spread credit redemption linearly over the first 6 months for 12-month term, first 9 months for 24-month term. Avoids heavy front-loading while still giving meaningful runway.
- Bridge months: keep 60 days but cap at $60k equivalent for onboarding (ZenHealth’s usage and egress patterns suggest that cap).
- Discount band: for 24-month commit, recommend 12-18% off list for dedicated unit pricing (bigger GPU pools get stepped pricing). For 12-month commit, 8-12%. Exact floor depends on whether they require strict limits on capacity (reserved-only) or allow burst to hosted pool.

I’ll prepare a clean numbers sheet tied to their $85k/mo baseline and include sample GPU pool sizing for the 8k model (3x A10g-equivalent GPUs to start, scale to 6 for +2x throughput headroom).

Karthik
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Sophie / Ryan —

Thanks for the patience. Based on your baseline (~$85k/mo hosted) and internal pricing guidance, here’s a succinct offer we can present to procurement today:

Offer summary (24-month preferred):
- Staged commits: 30% / 40% / 30% at months 0 / 4 / 9 of contract term.
- Conversion credit: 8x average monthly hosted spend (= $680k) applied as a billing credit against dedicated usage. Redemption: evenly across first 9 months.
- Bridge credit: 60-day onboarding credit capped at $60k (applies to first 60 days post-go-live).
- Pricing discount: 15% off list for dedicated unit pricing for a 24-month committed term.
- GPU pool sizing (starting): 3x A10g-equivalent for steady-state production on the 8k model; we’ll include autoscale to 6 for peak windows. Throughput SLA: tokens/sec per GPU documented in SOW; latency P99 target 0.9s for the offered configuration.

Attachments: updated spreadsheet with exact numbers and a draft DocuSign link to the staging SOW. If that looks good I’ll kick off the DocuSign and loop legal for the SOW redlines.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/12345-zenhealth
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/contacts/8291

Next steps: 1) confirm you want 24-month vs 12-month, 2) approve attachment and we’ll send DocuSign, 3) target go-live window and pilot dates (we recommend a 2-week pilot starting at least 30 days before full cutover).
